name: 3-TME
summary: 3-Thiometaescaline (3-TME), also known as 3-ethylthio-4,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of metaescaline in which the ethoxy group at the 3 position has been replaced with an ethylthio group.
